_doc: Device profiles in CSS points. w/h = full screen (native apps, react-native-web harness, PWAs with viewport-fit=cover). web.w / web.h = visible page size inside the default mobile browser (web.w defaults to w; on the iPhone Duo cover Safari keeps its controls in the side column, so the page is narrower than the screen) (Safari or Chrome UI takes the rest); shoot.mjs uses it in web mode. insets = safe-area insets a full-screen app must respect. chrome = system UI drawn over full-screen shots. crease = fold line for --guides. taps = system areas that swallow touches on the real device. approx names what was not measured on hardware or a simulator ("web.h": the browser height, "insets": safe areas and system bars, "all": the whole profile; several are comma separated): measure before relying on it, never guess new ones. Desktop profiles (platform windows or macos): w/h = screen size, web.h = page height in a maximized Chrome window (Chrome tab strip and toolbar 87pt, measured on macOS; Windows taskbar 48; macOS menu bar outside the notch area, Dock hidden); a bookmarks bar, a visible Dock or zoom make it shorter. aliases map model names to the profile with the same screen (iphone-16 renders as iphone-15). source says where newer profiles come from. Galaxy S26 and S26+ aliases are inferred from the S24/S25 pattern, not measured.

iphone-13-mini.label: iPhone 13 mini
iphone-13-mini.source: web.h derived: Safari page = h - top inset - 98 (iOS 26 and later, compact tab bar): measured 695 on 393x852 (real iPhone, iOS 26.5) and 714 on 402x874 (simulator, iOS 26.5), and 580 on the Duo cover (iOS 27.1)

galaxy-s24.label: Galaxy S24 / S25
galaxy-s24.source: 360x780 at DPR 3: firmware density 480 and real-traffic viewports (DeviceAtlas); status bar 34 dp and 3-button nav 48 dp measured on Samsung Remote Test Lab hardware (windowinsets.info); Chrome page height derived from the measured S Ultra

galaxy-s24-ultra.label: Galaxy S24+/Ultra, S25+/Ultra, A55, A15, A16
galaxy-s24-ultra.source: 384x832 at DPR 2.8125 (default FHD+): firmware density 450 and real-traffic viewports; status 34 dp and 3-button nav 48 dp measured on Remote Test Lab hardware; Chrome innerHeight 690 measured on an S Ultra

pixel-9.label: Pixel 9
pixel-9.source: 412x924 at DPR 2.625: device config density 420, real-traffic viewports, DevTools; status bar 54 dp and gesture bar 24 dp measured on the Android 17 emulator (DevTools gives 58); Chrome page = h - status - 56 (toolbar) - gesture bar, derived

pixel-9-pro-xl.label: Pixel 9 Pro XL
pixel-9-pro-xl.source: 448x998: measured traffic (DeviceAtlas); DPR 2.25 at the default 1008x2244 mode

galaxy-fold-cover.label: Galaxy Z Fold5 cover
galaxy-fold-cover.source: 344.38 x 882.29 dp at 420 dpi and status bar 32 dp measured on hardware (windowinsets.info), matches DevTools; 3-button nav 48 dp (Samsung default); Chrome page derived

galaxy-fold-open.label: Galaxy Z Fold5 open
galaxy-fold-open.source: 690.29 x 828.95 dp, crease x 345, status bar 30 dp measured on hardware (windowinsets.info); 3-button nav 48 dp; Chrome page derived

galaxy-fold7-cover.label: Galaxy Z Fold7 cover
galaxy-fold7-cover.source: 411.43 x 960 dp measured on hardware (windowinsets.info); Chrome reports 412 x 960 in real traffic (DeviceAtlas); status bar 42 dp; 3-button nav 48 dp; Chrome page derived

galaxy-fold7-open.label: Galaxy Z Fold7 open
galaxy-fold7-open.source: 749.71 x 832 dp, crease x 375 measured on hardware (windowinsets.info); Chrome reports 750 x 832 (DeviceAtlas); status bar 34 dp; 3-button nav 48 dp; Chrome page derived

duo-cover.label: iPhone Duo cover
duo-cover.source: measured 2026-10-06 on the Xcode 27.1 simulator: safe area top 0, bottom 34, right 84 (UIKit probe); Safari page 382 x 580 (Safari keeps its controls in the 84 pt side column); no home indicator

duo-open-l.label: iPhone Duo open landscape
duo-open-l.source: safe area and Safari page height measured 2026-10-06 on the Xcode 27.1 simulator (probe: top 0, bottom 34, right 84; Safari innerHeight 589); no home indicator

duo-open-p.label: iPhone Duo open portrait
duo-open-p.source: size from the Xcode 27.1 simulator; insets pending measurement; no home indicator on the Duo

duo-split-l.label: iPhone Duo Split View, side-by-side pane
duo-split-l.source: pane size from Apple (fixed 50/50 split across the crease); insets assumed equal to the measured open landscape screen for noon in the right pane (top 0, bottom 34, right 84), not measurable because automation cannot enter Split View; no home indicator

duo-split-p.label: iPhone Duo Split View, stacked pane
duo-split-p.source: pane size from Apple (fixed 50/50 split across the crease); insets not measurable (automation cannot enter Split View); no home indicator on the Duo
